sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: springsteenlyrics.com item pages: a copy the site has no scans of yet ("No scans available yet") was left out of the scans, so the page read as if the item had one copy. It now shows as a dashed box with the site's own words, in its place among the copies.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: springsteenlyrics.com item pages: an item's scans and artwork are one section. With several copies it has a chip per copy and By copy instead of By type, and the viewer steps through every copy's scans (before, each copy was its own section with its own viewer).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Other sites' detail pages (a Discogs release's or master's Tracks view, an archive.org item, a springsteenlyrics item or song page): their pictures now work like a release's Cover art on MusicBrainz. Type chips (Discogs' Primary and Secondary, archive.org's Front, Back, Booklet or Medium guessed from the file names, springsteenlyrics' Scan or Artwork), ★ on Discogs' primary image, Grid or By type (remembered for these pages, separately from MusicBrainz), and a click or Space opens the viewer over the pictures shown, with the page's title in its bar.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Cover art and Event art sections (release and event pages): the section now gets its pictures, loading and retry from one adapter, the first step toward one picture section for every detail page (springsteenlyrics scans, Discogs images, archive.org pictures). Nothing changes on screen. One fix comes with it: the Cover art tab finds its own section even when another picture section stands before it on the page.
